assumptions: Both methods evaluated on identical eligible cases
Missing/failed cases follow a frozen denominator policy
estimand: Mean candidate-minus-baseline difference over the frozen case population
estimator: Aggregate within independent units, then compute paired differences; retain per-case values
independent_unit: Case or independent cluster; declare nested repeats
limitations: Repeated runs within one case are dependent
A smaller p value alone does not establish useful improvement
stopping: Freeze attempts/budget and amendment policy before results
title: Paired comparison on the same cases
uncertainty: Choose paired or cluster-aware interval only after design checks; one dependent series may justify descriptive output without an interval

assumptions: Assignment and measurement units explicitly mapped
estimand: Effect at the declared experimental unit
estimator: Prespecified within-unit summary or a justified hierarchical analysis
independent_unit: Assigned device, incident, subject, workload or cluster
limitations: No universal sample-size threshold certifies independence
stopping: Record every planned repeat and failed attempt
title: Technical repeats and independent units
uncertainty: Unit/cluster resampling only where exchangeability and sufficient independent units are supported

assumptions: Features use only observations preceding each target
No algorithm tuning against heldout targets
Source vintage and prior access disclosed
estimand: Mean absolute forecast error on each frozen chronological partition
estimator: Per-target absolute error, partition MAE and paired error difference
independent_unit: One country series with temporally dependent target years
limitations: Annual targets from one country are not independent countries
Retrospective ordering does not establish historical data availability
reporting: Blank source unit and one-series limitations
stopping: One fixed execution plus separately recorded repair attempts
title: Descriptive comparison for one temporal series
uncertainty: No inferential interval for this small dependent development demonstration
